newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile to sell Colbun SA utility stake by December.
newsitem.headline: Chile to sell Colbun SA utility stake by December.

text.p: Chile plans to sell its 37.5 percent stake in Colbun Machicura SA by December at the latest, the electric utility's president, Jaime Toha, said Monday.

"We are still expecting economic offers on October 15, so from that day we should be deciding who the strategic partner is -- so the operation does not end any later than December," Toha told reporters.
Corfo, the state holding company that owns the stake, is discussing terms with the six international bidders short-listed for the sale in July, he said.
Colbun, the only large Chilean electric utility in which the state still owns a big stake, has a generating capacity of about 500 megawatts.
